title: Changing a SQLite column constraint

concepts.description: SQLite cannot alter most constraints in place, so the table is recreated, copied into and renamed.
concepts.context: 014_unique_slug.ts creates concepts_new, copies rows, drops concepts and renames the new table into place

concepts.description: PRAGMA foreign_keys is a no-op inside a transaction, so it has to be switched off before BEGIN or the DROP cascades.
concepts.context: db.pragma('foreign_keys = OFF') runs before db.transaction in 014_unique_slug.ts

concepts.description: foreign_key_check reports rows that violate declared references, which is how a rebuild proves it kept the graph intact.
concepts.context: the migration throws if db.pragma('foreign_key_check') returns rows, rolling the rebuild back

concepts.description: SQLite DDL is transactional, so a failure partway through a rebuild rolls every step back.
concepts.context: the CREATE, INSERT, DROP and RENAME in 014_unique_slug.ts share one db.transaction
